quests.question: You wonder exactly how the woven fabric in a cozy blanket was first made. Who wove it?
quests.hint: You wonder exactly how the woven fabric in a cozy blanket was first made. Who wove it?
quests.explanation: Great job! This is a weaver. Weavers cross threads together on a loom to make cloth.
quests.funFact: A weaver can turn plain thread into cloth with beautiful patterns!
quests.wordExample: The weaver crossed the colorful threads on her loom.

quests.question: You want to learn exactly how dolphins communicate with each other underwater. Who studies questions like that?
quests.hint: You want to learn exactly how dolphins communicate with each other underwater. Who studies questions like that?
quests.explanation: Well done! This is a marine biologist. Marine biologists study the plants and animals that live in the ocean.
quests.funFact: A marine biologist might study a single kind of fish for years!
quests.wordExample: The marine biologist studied a school of colorful fish.

quests.question: You want to know the name of that unusually bright star in the night sky. Who could tell you?
quests.hint: You want to know the name of that unusually bright star in the night sky. Who could tell you?
quests.explanation: Well done! This is an astronomer. Astronomers study stars, planets, and space using powerful telescopes.
quests.funFact: An astronomer can spot a star that is millions of miles away!
quests.wordExample: The astronomer pointed the telescope at a bright new star.

quests.question: Your grandpa's old watch stopped ticking and needs its tiny parts fixed. Who could repair it?
quests.hint: Your grandpa's old watch stopped ticking and needs its tiny parts fixed. Who could repair it?
quests.explanation: That's right! This is a watchmaker. Watchmakers build and repair watches with tiny, careful parts.
quests.funFact: Some watchmakers use a special magnifying glass worn over one eye.
quests.wordExample: The watchmaker used a magnifying glass to see the small parts.

quests.question: You bought a handmade clay mug at a craft fair last weekend. Who shaped it?
quests.hint: You bought a handmade clay mug at a craft fair last weekend. Who shaped it?
quests.explanation: That's right! This is a potter. Potters shape clay into bowls, cups, and other pottery.
quests.funFact: Potters bake their clay creations in a very hot oven called a kiln.
quests.wordExample: The potter shaped the clay into a smooth bowl.

quests.question: A sturdy stone wall is being built around a new garden. Who is building it, brick by brick?
quests.hint: A sturdy stone wall is being built around a new garden. Who is building it, brick by brick?
quests.explanation: Correct! This is a mason. Masons build walls and structures using brick or stone.
quests.funFact: Masons use a tool called a trowel to spread cement between bricks.
quests.wordExample: The mason stacked bricks to build a garden wall.

quests.question: You see a beautiful statue standing in the park. Who carved or shaped it?
quests.hint: You see a beautiful statue standing in the park. Who carved or shaped it?
quests.explanation: Great job! This is a sculptor. Sculptors carve or shape material like stone or metal into art.
quests.funFact: A sculptor can spend months carefully carving a single statue!
quests.wordExample: The sculptor carved a statue from a block of stone.

quests.question: Your bedroom walls look dull and you want a bright new color. Who could paint them for you?
quests.hint: Your bedroom walls look dull and you want a bright new color. Who could paint them for you?
quests.explanation: Correct! This is a house painter. House painters paint the walls of homes and buildings.
quests.funFact: House painters carefully cover furniture before they start painting.
quests.wordExample: The house painter rolled fresh paint onto the wall.

quests.question: You see someone at an outdoor show with a trained hawk perched calmly on their arm. Who trained it to do that?
quests.hint: You see someone at an outdoor show with a trained hawk perched calmly on their arm. Who trained it to do that?
quests.explanation: Well done! This is a falconer. Falconers train and care for falcons and other birds of prey.
quests.funFact: A falconer wears a thick leather glove so a falcon can land safely on their arm!
quests.wordExample: The falconer fed the falcon after its flight.

quests.question: You wonder who was the very first person to reach the top of a tall, unclimbed mountain. Who does daring things like that?
quests.hint: You wonder who was the very first person to reach the top of a tall, unclimbed mountain. Who does daring things like that?
quests.explanation: Great job! This is an explorer. Explorers travel to new places to discover and learn about them.
quests.funFact: Explorers once sailed for months without knowing exactly what they'd find!
quests.wordExample: The explorer used a compass to find her way through the jungle.

quests.question: You wonder how your favorite toy was made before it ever reached the store shelf. Who designed and built it?
quests.hint: You wonder how your favorite toy was made before it ever reached the store shelf. Who designed and built it?
quests.explanation: Well done! This is a toy maker. Toy makers design and build fun toys for children.
quests.funFact: A toy maker might build hundreds of toys before choosing the best design!
quests.wordExample: The toy maker built a wooden train for the toy shop.

quests.question: You love the sparkly outfit a character wears in your favorite movie. Who designed and made it?
quests.hint: You love the sparkly outfit a character wears in your favorite movie. Who designed and made it?
quests.explanation: You got it! This is a costume designer. Costume designers create the special outfits worn in movies and plays.
quests.funFact: Costume designers study the story carefully before designing each outfit.
quests.wordExample: The costume designer sketched a new outfit for the actor.

quests.question: You love the music playing during your favorite movie's most exciting scene. Who wrote it?
quests.hint: You love the music playing during your favorite movie's most exciting scene. Who wrote it?
quests.explanation: Well done! This is a composer. Composers write original music for others to play or sing.
quests.funFact: A composer can hear a whole song in their head before writing a single note!
quests.wordExample: The composer played the melody on the piano first.

quests.question: You're watching a beautiful ballet performance at the theater. Who is moving so gracefully on stage?
quests.hint: You're watching a beautiful ballet performance at the theater. Who is moving so gracefully on stage?
quests.explanation: You got it! This is a dancer. Dancers move to music to tell a story or share a feeling.
quests.funFact: Some dances tell an entire story without using any words at all!
quests.wordExample: The dancer spun gracefully across the stage.

quests.question: Workers just found what looks like an ancient clay pot buried underground. Who should study it?
quests.hint: Workers just found what looks like an ancient clay pot buried underground. Who should study it?
quests.explanation: You got it! This is an archaeologist. Archaeologists dig up and study objects from ancient times.
quests.funFact: Archaeologists study old ruins to learn how people lived long ago.
quests.wordExample: The archaeologist studied the ancient ruins.

quests.question: This person crosses threads together on a loom to create brand-new cloth, rather than sewing finished clothes to fit. Are they a weaver or a tailor?
quests.hint: This person crosses threads together on a loom to create brand-new cloth, rather than sewing finished clothes to fit. Are they a weaver or a tailor?
quests.explanation: You got it! This is a weaver. Weavers cross threads together on a loom to make cloth.
quests.funFact: Weavers use a tool called a loom to cross threads together.
quests.wordExample: The weaver made a warm blanket from soft wool.

quests.question: Before workers can build a brand new school, someone has to draw the plan for it. Who does that?
quests.hint: Before workers can build a brand new school, someone has to draw the plan for it. Who does that?
quests.explanation: Correct! This is an architect. Architects design buildings before workers start to build them.
quests.funFact: Some architects build tiny models of a building before it's ever built.
quests.wordExample: The architect showed us a model of the new school.

quests.question: You wonder how the cereal boxes traveled from the factory all the way to your grocery store shelf. Who drove them there?
quests.hint: You wonder how the cereal boxes traveled from the factory all the way to your grocery store shelf. Who drove them there?
quests.explanation: Well done! This is a truck driver. Truck drivers drive big trucks to deliver goods to stores and homes.
quests.funFact: A truck driver might carry food, furniture, or even toys!
quests.wordExample: The truck driver delivered boxes to the store.

quests.question: Someone needs help understanding their rights and speaking up for themselves in court. Who could help them?
quests.hint: Someone needs help understanding their rights and speaking up for themselves in court. Who could help them?
quests.explanation: Yes! This is a lawyer. Lawyers help and speak for people who need help with the law.
quests.funFact: A lawyer reads carefully through many papers before every case.
quests.wordExample: The lawyer helped explain the contract to her client.

quests.question: This person repairs the tiny gears inside a broken watch, rather than designing jewelry with gems. Are they a watchmaker or a jeweler?
quests.hint: This person repairs the tiny gears inside a broken watch, rather than designing jewelry with gems. Are they a watchmaker or a jeweler?
quests.explanation: Great job! This is a watchmaker. Watchmakers build and repair watches with tiny, careful parts.
quests.funFact: A watchmaker works with gears so tiny they're smaller than a grain of rice!
quests.wordExample: The watchmaker fixed the tiny gears inside the watch.

quests.question: You're riding in the car and someone is chatting and playing songs on the radio. Who is that?
quests.hint: You're riding in the car and someone is chatting and playing songs on the radio. Who is that?
quests.explanation: You got it! This is a radio host. Radio hosts talk and play music for listeners on the radio.
quests.funFact: Radio hosts often answer calls from listeners live on the air.
quests.wordExample: The radio host shared a funny story on the air.

quests.question: The _____ carved a statue from a block of stone.
quests.hint: The _____ carved a statue from a block of stone.
quests.explanation: You got it! This is a sculptor. Sculptors carve or shape material like stone or metal into art.
quests.funFact: Sculptors sometimes make a small clay model before carving the real statue.
quests.wordExample: The sculptor carved a statue from a block of stone.

quests.question: You wonder who trains hard every day and works as a team to help protect their whole country. Who is that?
quests.hint: You wonder who trains hard every day and works as a team to help protect their whole country. Who is that?
quests.explanation: You got it! This is a soldier. Soldiers train hard and work together to protect their country.
quests.funFact: Soldiers train for many months to learn teamwork and discipline.
quests.wordExample: The soldiers marched together in a straight line.

quests.question: You're at a birthday party and everyone wants to dance to fun music. Who is playing all the songs?
quests.hint: You're at a birthday party and everyone wants to dance to fun music. Who is playing all the songs?
quests.explanation: You got it! This is a DJ. DJs play and mix music to keep a party or event fun.
quests.funFact: DJs read the crowd to choose exactly the right song to play next.
quests.wordExample: The DJ played our favorite song at the party.

quests.question: You're at a party and want someone silly to make everyone giggle. Who could you invite?
quests.hint: You're at a party and want someone silly to make everyone giggle. Who could you invite?
quests.explanation: You got it! This is a clown. Clowns wear funny costumes and makeup to make people laugh.
quests.funFact: Clowns often perform at parties, parades, and the circus.
quests.wordExample: The clown twisted a balloon into a funny shape.

quests.question: Your dog hurt its paw while playing outside and needs help. Who should you take it to?
quests.hint: Your dog hurt its paw while playing outside and needs help. Who should you take it to?
quests.explanation: Nice work! This is a vet. Vets take care of sick or hurt animals.
quests.funFact: A vet might care for a tiny hamster and a huge horse on the same day!
quests.wordExample: The vet gently checked the bird's wing.

quests.question: You wonder why the sky looks blue during the day. Who studies questions like that for a living?
quests.hint: You wonder why the sky looks blue during the day. Who studies questions like that for a living?
quests.explanation: Well done! This is a scientist. Scientists ask questions and do experiments to learn how the world works.
quests.funFact: A scientist's most important tool is asking good questions!
quests.wordExample: The scientist mixed two liquids to see what would happen.

quests.question: You see a brand new building rising downtown, a little taller every week. Who is building it?
quests.hint: You see a brand new building rising downtown, a little taller every week. Who is building it?
quests.explanation: Correct! This is a construction worker. Construction workers build houses, roads, and tall buildings.
quests.funFact: It can take hundreds of construction workers to build one tall building!
quests.wordExample: The construction workers built a new school near our house.

quests.question: You need to cross a busy street on your way into school. Who helps you cross safely?
quests.hint: You need to cross a busy street on your way into school. Who helps you cross safely?
quests.explanation: Well done! This is a crossing guard. Crossing guards help children cross the street safely near school.
quests.funFact: A crossing guard holds up a sign so cars know to stop.
quests.wordExample: The crossing guard held up her sign so we could cross.

quests.question: You wonder how so many airplanes land at the same busy airport without ever bumping into each other. Who guides them safely?
quests.hint: You wonder how so many airplanes land at the same busy airport without ever bumping into each other. Who guides them safely?
quests.explanation: Great job! This is an air traffic controller. Air traffic controllers guide airplanes safely from a tower.
quests.funFact: Air traffic controllers watch airplanes carefully on a screen in their tower.
quests.wordExample: The air traffic controller told the pilot it was safe to land.
